user.title: Chronik
user.description: Name of the Chronik. Afterwards you choose the sources per category – every page is optional and can be changed later in the options.

rain.title: Rain
rain.description: A sensor with the daily (or total) rain amount. Every increase is recorded; a pause longer than the gap starts a new rain episode.

data_description.rain_gap_minutes: Without new rain for this long, the episode ends.

irrigation.title: Irrigation
irrigation.description: One entity per zone that is on/open while the zone is watering. Optionally a water meter for the volume.

mowing.title: Mowing
mowing.description: Lawn mowers. Short pauses (e.g. charging) are merged into one mowing session.

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: Entities that are active during backwash (timer, switch …) and/or counters that are reset after backwashing (e.g. pump hours since backwash).

data_description.pool_reset_threshold: A drop of a counter to this value or below counts as reset.

alarm.title: Alarms
alarm.description: Alarm panels (recorded when triggered), sirens and binary sensors (recorded while on).

ai.title: AI findings
ai.description: Text entities (input_text/sensor) holding AI results. Every new text becomes an entry.

data_description.ai_image_dirs: Images saved here shortly before a finding are attached to it, e.g. /media/llmvision/snapshots. One folder per line.
data_description.ai_image_window_minutes: How many minutes before the finding an image may have been saved.
